objective: Promote what the source watch captured into the evidence vault, a bounded batch a wake, in priority order, each capture read first.
session: its persistent session (scheduled curator), woken by two scheduled tasks
instructions: Scheduled curator wake. Follow "Each scheduled wake" in the curator prompt (admin/content/briefs/2026-10-23__brief__the-scheduled-curator.md), with two changes the editor made on 23 October: (1) the queue is now in the PACK vault 7r83qic5, cloned at scratchpad clones/watch-pack (sgit-ai 0.24.0; `sgit fetch` then `sgit pull` there, not in the old clones/watch); (2) match queue rows to the vault by URL as well as slug (my first 15 promotions used my own slugs), and add a snapshot of an already-held URL as a new capture of that source. Tools in the scratchpad: tools/read_rows.py START END (reads pending rows), tools/promote_rows.py SPEC.json (writes after a dry pass; spec is JSON with slug, summary, quote_original verbatim, quote_en, claims). If the evidence clone's .sg_vault or the pki key pair (/root/.sg-send/keys) is gone, say "needs a new key handshake" and stop. Promote a bounded batch (about 18) of pending rows per wake, priority order, reading each capture first; if none pending, say "nothing new" in one line and do not commit. Push with sgit --token "$SG_SEND_ACCESS_TOKEN" push. Never print a key or token.
each_wake: As its instructions say; from now on, also: take in dev, read its inbox (schedule.py inbox curator), write a run record (schedule.py run curator) and release it.
